purpose: S10 adds the D3 pre-join preview to the invitations module: the sponsor sends a gift-wrapped kind-21064 invite-context rumor {groupId,name} after a delivered/retryable invite; the invitee's inbox handler validates, dedupes and holds it (8/sender, 64 total, 7 days); a pure card view model shows the sponsor's group name (untrusted text) or the generic label, never a description or admin list.

public_api.name: createInviteContextSender
public_api.signature: (deps: { inbox: { sendInboxRumor }; ownPubkey: string; now: () => number; onError? }) => { sendAfterInvite(result: InviteOutcome | NoUsableKeyPackage | AlreadyMember, target: { to; groupId; name }): Promise<'sent' | 'skipped' | 'failed'> }
public_api.description: Sends exactly one extensions.sendInboxRumor of kind 21064, content {"groupId":..,"name":..} only, after delivered/retryable; failed/declined/error values send nothing; a rejection is reported, never thrown. Account-scope call: UI handler / queued job only.

public_api.name: createContextSendingInviter
public_api.signature: (deps: { inviter: KeyPackageInviter; sender: InviteContextSender }) => { inviteByPubkey(group: InviteGroup & { name }, pubkey, opts?) }
public_api.description: KeyPackageInviter decorated with the context send; returns the invite result unchanged.

public_api.name: sanitizeContextName / parseInviteContextContent / buildInviteContextContent / MAX_CONTEXT_NAME_LENGTH / INVITE_CONTEXT_KIND
public_api.signature: pure helpers; cap 64 code points; kind = APP_INBOX_KINDS.inviteContext (21064)
public_api.description: Untrusted-name normalisation (control/bidi removed, whitespace collapsed, capped, markup left literal) and strict payload parsing that never carries extra keys.

public_api.name: createInviteContextStore
public_api.signature: (deps: { port: { load; save }; now; getPending: () => InvitationRef[]; onError? }) => InviteContextStore
public_api.description: Holding store keyed groupId+sender: add (dedupe by rumor id, replace by key), reconcile(pending) (7-day expiry, sponsor validation, invitation-left deletion, held caps 8/sender 64 total oldest first), discard(group), snapshot(), subscribe(). Whole-snapshot persistence through the injected port; never calls the client.

public_api.name: bindInviteContextToPendingView / withInviteContextCleanup
public_api.description: Reconcile on every pending-list change; discard a group's contexts after a successful accept/decline.

public_api.name: createInviteContextHandler
public_api.signature: (deps: { store: { add }; denyLayer: DenyLayer; onError? }) => InboxRumorHandler
public_api.description: Registered by the bootstrap for APP_INBOX_KINDS.inviteContext. Drops wrong kind, blocked sender (before storing), malformed payload; sender = seal-bound rumor.pubkey. Persist-and-return, no account-scope client call.

public_api.name: buildInvitationCardViewModel / buildInvitationCardViewModels
public_api.signature: ({ invitation, contexts, genericLabel, now }) => { invitationId, displayName, nameSource: 'context' | 'generic', sponsorAccount }
public_api.description: Pure. Name only from a context whose sender is sponsorAccount or in sponsors[]; sanitised and capped again; no description/admin fields exist in the model.

owned_data: few-invite-contexts IndexedDB database (one whole-snapshot record per account pubkey; access only through createIdbInviteContextPort)
dependencies_allowed: invitations/denyLayer (DenyLayer, S9), invitations/invite (types, S8), invitations/pendingView (view structurally, S9)
idb-keyval (only in app/src/lib/marmot/inviteContextIdbPort.ts, outside the pure invitations/ directory)
dependencies_forbidden: client/ construction or any MarmotClient call from the handler or store
publishing the context outside sendInboxRumor (privacy invariant)
external_ports: extensions.sendInboxRumor (library, account scope: UI handler / queued job only)
extensions.registerInboxHandler (registered by client/ bootstrap, existing inboxHandlers.inviteContext slot)
InviteContextStorePort { load, save } (IndexedDB adapter in lib/marmot/inviteContextIdbPort.ts)
events_emitted: InviteContextStore.subscribe: fires after every change of the held set (live card update in either arrival order)
